name: @activepieces/piece-famulor
description: AI-powered calling and SMS platform. Automate outbound campaigns, manage leads, and get real-time call analytics.

auth.description: Create an API key in your Famulor account and paste the value here. Get API key here -> https://app.famulor.de.

addLead.name: addLead
addLead.description: Add a lead to an outbound campaign to be called by an AI assistant.

phone_number.description: Enter the phone number of the customer (E.164 format: +1234567890)

variables.description: Variables to pass to the assistant

allow_dupplicate.description: Allow the same phone number to be added to the campaign more than once

num_secondary_contacts.description: How many secondary contacts do you want to add? (Max: 10)

secondary_contacts.description: Add secondary contacts for this lead. Each contact can have its own phone number and variables.

aiMetadata.description: Enqueue a lead (primary phone number plus optional template variables and up to ten secondary contacts) into an existing campaign for the AI assistant to call. Pick when populating a campaign with people to dial. Not idempotent — each call appends a lead unless allow_dupplicate is left off, which can still create repeats across calls.

listLeads.name: listLeads
listLeads.description: List all leads in your account.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve all leads in the account. Use to enumerate leads or to find a lead's ID before updating or assigning it. Read-only and idempotent.

listPhoneNumbers.name: listPhoneNumbers
listPhoneNumbers.description: List all phone numbers linked to your account.

aiMetadata.description: List the phone numbers already owned by / linked to the account. Use to discover which numbers are available to send from or assign; to find new numbers to buy use Search Available Phone Numbers instead. Read-only and idempotent.

searchAvailablePhoneNumbers.name: searchAvailablePhoneNumbers
searchAvailablePhoneNumbers.description: Search for phone numbers available to purchase.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to search in (supported regions per Famulor docs).

contains.description: Optional. Only return numbers that contain these digits (numeric only, max 10 digits).

aiMetadata.description: Search the catalog of phone numbers available to purchase, filtered by country code and an optional digit/pattern match. Use to find candidate numbers before buying one with Purchase Phone Number. Read-only and idempotent; it browses inventory and does not buy anything.

purchasePhoneNumber.name: purchasePhoneNumber
purchasePhoneNumber.description: Purchase a phone number from the available search results.

phone_number.description: Exact E.164 value from Search Available Phone Numbers. Requires a payment method on file; creates a monthly subscription. (E.164 format: +1234567890)

aiMetadata.description: Buy a specific phone number (from Search Available Phone Numbers results) and add it to the account. Use after confirming an available number; this incurs a charge and provisions a real number, so it is not idempotent. To browse purchasable numbers first use Search Available Phone Numbers.

sendSms.name: sendSms
sendSms.description: Send an SMS message using one of your purchased phone numbers.

from.description: Select an SMS-capable phone number to send from

to.description: Enter the recipient's phone number (E.164 format: +1234567890)

bodysuit.description: SMS message content (max 300 characters). Long messages may be split into multiple segments.

aiMetadata.description: Send a single SMS text message from one of the account's purchased numbers to a recipient. Use for plain SMS delivery; for WhatsApp use the WhatsApp send actions instead. Each call delivers a new message, so it is not idempotent.

createCampaign.name: createCampaign
createCampaign.description: Create a new outbound calling campaign.

name.description: Name of the outbound campaign (max 255 characters)

assistant_id.description: Select the AI assistant to use for the call

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Berlin, America/New_York). Leave empty for account default.

max_calls_in_parallel.description: 1–10 simultaneous calls (your plan may limit further)

allowed_days.description: Leave empty to use API default (all days). Otherwise restrict to selected days.

retry_on_voicemail.description: Retry when the call reaches voicemail

retry_on_goal_incomplete.description: Retry when the call goal was not completed

goal_completion_variable.description: Name of a boolean variable from the assistant post-call schema (max 255 characters)

mark_complete_when_no_leads.description: Mark the campaign complete when there are no leads left to call

phone_number_ids.description: Optional. Caller IDs for this campaign (distinct phone number IDs).

aiMetadata.description: Create a new outbound calling campaign bound to an AI assistant, optionally configuring dialing windows (timezone, allowed hours/days), parallelism, and retry behavior. Pick when setting up a fresh campaign before adding leads to it; this always creates a new campaign (not idempotent — repeated calls make duplicates).

campaignControl.name: campaignControl
campaignControl.description: Start or stop an outbound calling campaign.

action.description: Select the action to perform on the campaign

aiMetadata.description: Start or stop an outbound calling campaign by campaign ID, choosing the action via the start/stop mode. Use to launch bulk outbound dialing of a campaign's leads or to halt it. Idempotent with respect to end state: starting an already-running campaign or stopping a stopped one converges on the requested state.

makePhoneCall.name: makePhoneCall
makePhoneCall.description: Initiate an AI-powered phone call to a customer.

assistant_id.description: Select the AI assistant to use for the call

phone_number.description: Enter the phone number to call (E.164 format: +1234567890)

variable.description: Variables to pass to the assistant during the call

aiMetadata.description: Place a single outbound AI-assistant phone call to one customer number, using the chosen assistant and optional template variables. Use for one-off calls; for bulk outbound calling use a campaign (Start/Stop Campaign) instead. Each invocation dials a new call, so it is not idempotent.

campaign.description: Optionally assign the lead to a different campaign

phone_number.description: New phone number in E.164 format (leave empty to keep unchanged) (E.164 format: +1234567890)

status.description: Lead status: created, completed, or reached-max-retries (leave unselected to keep unchanged)

variables.description: Custom fields merged with existing lead variables (leave empty to skip)

aiMetadata.description: Update fields on an existing lead identified by lead ID — campaign assignment, phone number, status, and/or custom variables. At least one field must be supplied or the action errors. Idempotent: re-sending the same values leaves the lead in the same state.

deleteLead.name: deleteLead
deleteLead.description: Permanently delete a lead and abort any ongoing calls.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently remove a lead by its ID, aborting any call currently in progress for it. Pick when a lead should be dropped from a campaign entirely; this is destructive and irreversible. Not idempotent in effect — once deleted, a subsequent call targeting the same ID will fail to find it.

getCurrentUser.name: getCurrentUser
getCurrentUser.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile and account balance.

aiMetadata.description: Get the authenticated user's profile and current account balance for the supplied API credentials. Use to verify the connection or check available balance before placing calls or sending messages. Read-only and idempotent.

generateAiReply.name: generateAiReply
generateAiReply.description: Generate an AI reply from an assistant for a given customer.

assistant_id.description: Select the assistant to generate a response with

customer_identifier.description: A unique identifier for the customer (e.g., phone number, email, CRM contact ID). Maximum length: 255 characters.

message.description: The customer's message to respond to

variables.description: Optional context variables to pass to the assistant

aiMetadata.description: Generate (draft) an AI assistant reply to a customer message, identified by assistant and customer identifier, with optional template variables. Use to obtain suggested reply text without it being committed to a conversation; to post a message into a real thread use Send Message. Each call generates fresh output, so it is not idempotent.

createConversation.name: createConversation
createConversation.description: Start a new chat conversation with an AI assistant.

assistant_id.description: The UUID of the assistant to start the conversation with

variables.description: Custom variables to pass to the assistant

aiMetadata.description: Start a brand-new chat conversation with an AI assistant, optionally as a widget or test conversation and with initial variables. Use to open a fresh thread before sending messages; each call creates a new conversation, so it is not idempotent. To continue an existing thread use Send Message instead.

getConversation.name: getConversation
getConversation.description: Retrieve the full message history for a conversation.

uuid.description: The unique UUID identifier of the conversation to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the complete message history of one conversation by its UUID. Use to read prior turns before deciding how to reply or to inspect a thread's contents. Read-only and idempotent.

sendMessage.name: sendMessage
sendMessage.description: Send a message to an existing conversation and receive the assistant's reply.

uuid.description: The unique UUID identifier of the conversation

message.description: User message to send (max 2000 characters). The assistant's reply is returned in the action output field `message`.

aiMetadata.description: Post a message into an existing Famulor conversation (identified by its UUID) and get back the AI assistant's reply in the same call. Use to continue a chat thread you already created or retrieved; not idempotent, as each call appends a new message and generates a new reply.

getWhatsAppSenders.name: getWhatsAppSenders
getWhatsAppSenders.description: List WhatsApp Business senders linked to your account.

status.description: Online only (default API behavior) or all senders including offline. Use sender `id` as sender_id when sending WhatsApp messages.

aiMetadata.description: List the WhatsApp Business senders connected to the account, optionally filtered to only online senders versus all. Read-only and idempotent. Pick this to discover a valid sender_id before sending a WhatsApp template message.

getWhatsAppTemplates.name: getWhatsAppTemplates
getWhatsAppTemplates.description: List approved WhatsApp message templates for a sender.

sender_id.description: WhatsApp sender numeric ID from Get WhatsApp Senders (the sender `id` field)

status.description: Approved templates only (default API behavior) or all templates including pending/rejected

aiMetadata.description: List the WhatsApp message templates registered to a given sender, defaulting to approved templates with an option to return all statuses. Use to discover which templates can be sent (e.g. to start a conversation outside the 24-hour session window). Read-only and idempotent.

sendWhatsAppTemplate.name: sendWhatsAppTemplate
sendWhatsAppTemplate.description: Send an approved WhatsApp template message via a Famulor sender.

sender_id.description: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders

template_id.description: Template ID from Get WhatsApp Templates (must be approved)

recipient_name.description: Optional. Used for conversation tracking and CRM (max 255 characters)

variables.description: Key-value pairs: use "1", "2", … or names from the template `variables` array. Leave empty if the template has no placeholders.

aiMetadata.description: Send a pre-approved WhatsApp Business template message to a recipient phone number through a specific Famulor sender, filling any template variables. Pick when initiating outbound WhatsApp contact; requires a sender_id and template_id that already exist on the account. Not idempotent — each call dispatches a new message.

sendWhatsAppFreeform.name: sendWhatsAppFreeform
sendWhatsAppFreeform.description: Send a free-text WhatsApp message within an active 24-hour session.

sender_id.description: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders (sender must be online)

message.description: Free-text content (max 4096 characters). Only works within an active 24-hour messaging window; otherwise send a template first.

aiMetadata.description: Send a free-text (non-template) WhatsApp message from a sender to a recipient. This only works while a 24-hour customer-initiated session is open; outside that window a pre-approved template is required instead (see Get WhatsApp Templates). Check the window first with Get WhatsApp Session Status. Each call sends a new message, so it is not idempotent.

getWhatsAppSessionStatus.name: getWhatsAppSessionStatus
getWhatsAppSessionStatus.description: Check if a 24-hour WhatsApp messaging session is active for a sender and recipient.

sender_id.description: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders

recipient_phone.description: Recipient to check the 24-hour window for (E.164 format: +1234567890)

aiMetadata.description: Check whether a 24-hour WhatsApp messaging window is currently open between a given sender and recipient. Use before sending a free-text WhatsApp message to decide whether Send WhatsApp Freeform is allowed or a pre-approved template is required. Read-only and idempotent.

assistant_id.description: Filter by assistant numeric ID (must belong to your account)

whatsapp_sender_phone.description: Filter by WhatsApp Business sender number (exact match)

per_page.description: Page size (1–100). Default on the API is 15 if omitted.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (paste next_cursor from a previous list response)

aiMetadata.description: List conversations, optionally filtered by channel type, assistant, customer phone, WhatsApp sender phone, or external identifier, with cursor-based pagination. Use to find a conversation or its UUID; to read one thread's messages use Get Conversation. Read-only and idempotent.

per_page.description: Results per page (1–100). API default is 15.

aiMetadata.description: List call records, optionally narrowed by status, direction (inbound/outbound), phone number, assistant, campaign, date range, and paginated. Use to browse or search calls; to fetch one call's full transcript and recording use Get Call instead. Read-only and idempotent.

getCall.name: getCall
getCall.description: Retrieve details for a call by ID, including transcript and recording.

call_id.description: Numeric ID of the call (from list calls or Famulor UI)

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the full details of a single call by its numeric ID, including transcript and recording. Use when you already have a call ID and need its content; to discover or filter calls first use List Calls. Read-only and idempotent.

deleteCall.name: deleteCall
deleteCall.description: Permanently delete a call record including its transcript and recording.

call_id.description: Numeric ID of the call to delete permanently (transcript, recording, and metadata are removed)

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a single call record (transcript and recording included) by its numeric call ID. Use only when a caller explicitly wants a call purged; this is destructive and cannot be undone. Repeating the call on an already-deleted ID will not restore data, so treat it as non-idempotent.

phoneCallEnded.name: phoneCallEnded
phoneCallEnded.description: Triggers when a phone call completes.

assistant_id.description: Select an assistant to receive post-call webhook notifications for

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Famulor AI phone call finishes, delivering the full post-call result via webhook. The payload includes call metadata (customer and assistant phone numbers, duration, status, timestamps), the conversation transcript and recording URL, AI-extracted variables (e.g. interest, appointment scheduled, follow-up needed), the input variables passed in, and the associated lead and campaign. Use to act on outcomes of completed inbound or outbound calls.

conversationEnded.name: conversationEnded
conversationEnded.description: Triggers when a chat conversation ends.

assistant_id.description: Select the assistant whose chat conversations (WhatsApp or web widget) should send this webhook when a conversation ends

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Famulor chat conversation (WhatsApp or web widget) for the selected assistant ends, delivering the full result via webhook. The payload includes the conversation and assistant IDs, channel type, message count, status, AI-extracted variables and summary, input variables, the raw and formatted transcript, customer name/phone, and start and end timestamps. Use to act on the outcome of a completed text conversation.

getAssistants.name: getAssistants
getAssistants.description: Triggers when AI assistants are created or updated in your Famulor account.

per_page.description: Number of assistants to fetch per page (1-100, default: 10)

aiMetadata.description: Polls the Famulor account and fires when an AI assistant is newly created or updated, deduplicating by the assistant's updated/created timestamp. Optionally filter by assistant type (inbound or outbound). Each emitted item is the full assistant record, including id, name, type, status, phone number, voice and language, timezone, initial message, system prompt, max duration, recording flag, custom variables, webhook configuration, and create/update timestamps. Use to keep an external system in sync with assistant configuration changes.

sampleData.name: Customer Support Assistant
sampleData.initial_message: Hello! How can I help you today?
sampleData.system_prompt: You are a helpful customer support assistant.

inboundCall.name: inboundCall
inboundCall.description: Triggers when an inbound call is received by your AI assistant.

assistant_id.description: Select an inbound assistant to receive webhook notifications for

aiMetadata.description: Fires at the moment an inbound phone call reaches the selected Famulor inbound assistant, delivering an early webhook notification before the call completes. The payload includes the assistant ID, the customer (caller) and assistant phone numbers, a call ID, a timestamp, the call status (e.g. incoming), and any known caller variables. Use to react to an incoming call as it starts, such as looking up the caller or logging the contact.
